#define __SYSCALL_32BIT_ARG_BYTES 16
#include "SYS.h"

#ifndef SYS_mknodat
#define SYS_mknodat 554
#elif SYS_mknodat != 554
#error "Unexpected mknodat syscall number"
#endif

#ifndef SYS_mknodat
#error "SYS_mknodat not defined. The header files libsyscall is building against do not match syscalls.master."
#endif

#if defined(__arm64__)
MI_ENTRY_POINT(_mknodat)
SYSCALL_NONAME(mknodat, 4, cerror_nocancel)
ret
#else
#if defined(__arm64__) || defined(__i386__) || defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__ppc__)
__SYSCALL2(_mknodat, mknodat, 4, cerror_nocancel)
#endif

#endif
